scripts.dev: npm -w @sijagakali/shared run build && concurrently --names "collector,processing,notification,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta,green" "npm run dev:collector" "npm run dev:processing" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm -w @sijagakali/shared run build && npm -w @sijagakali/mqtt-collector exec -- tsc && npm -w @sijagakali/data-processing exec -- tsc && npm -w @sijagakali/notification-gateway exec -- tsc && npm -w @sijagakali/api exec -- tsc
scripts.start: concurrently --names "collector,processing,notification,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta,green" "npm run start:collector" "npm run start:processing" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:api"
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
